description: Risk R-B first, because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is TransactionAddController, and this program adds nothing - it VIEWS. Four independent artefacts say so: app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 'Function    : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file', README.md:314 '| CT01 | COTRN01 | COTRN01C | Transaction View |', app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 'CardDemo - Transaction View' and the on-screen literal INITIAL='View Transaction' at POS=(4,30) - app/bms/COTRN01.bms:78-79. The mapset corroborates it structurally: 56 DFHMDF entries, 21 named, and exactly ONE UNPROT - TRNIDIN at :85 - which is a lookup-then-display screen and not a data-entry screen. Rule R1 resolves the conflict - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so it is documented here and never silently corrected. THIS CASE IS WHERE THE MISLEADING NAME IS MOST DANGEROUS, and the warning is the point of the fixture: a controller called Add receives a key that is NOT IN THE FILE and MUST NOT CREATE THE RECORD. It reports 'Transaction ID NOT found...' and stops. Nothing is inserted, nothing is written, nothing is locked into existence: expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion, the adapter verifies on every case that no mutating repository method was reached, and the three seeded rows are pinned unchanged afterwards. A translation that read the name rather than the source would turn precisely this path into an insert, which is why the assertion is stated three ways. The half of the swap that genuinely ADDS a transaction is COTRN02C, and its cases live in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: the DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm of the keyed read reached on the REENTER plus DFHENTER path - the counterpart of case05, which reaches the same arm and the same message from the first-entry direction. THE TRACE, arm by arm. :88-92 sets ERR-FLG-OFF and USR-MODIFIED-NO and blanks WS-MESSAGE and ERRMSGO. EIBCALEN is 218, so :94 takes its else arm and :98 copies the passed area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives at 1, so CDEMO-PGM-REENTER already holds at :99 and control takes the ELSE at :110-111 - which is why the echoed context is still 1 and why the :100 SET, the :101 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN1AO and the :102 MOVE -1 never run. :111 performs RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN (:230-238), then the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :112 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER, and performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. The EVALUATE TRUE at :146 takes its SECOND arm - TRNIDINI is populated, so it is neither SPACES nor LOW-VALUES - and that arm is MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL (:154) followed by CONTINUE, with no message and no send. WS-ERR-FLG is therefore still 'N', so :158 IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is TRUE: the thirteen detail items are blanked in source order at :159-171 (TRNIDI, CARDNUMI, TTYPCDI, TCATCDI, TRNSRCI, TRNAMTI, TDESCI, TORIGDTI, TPROCDTI, MIDI, MNAMEI, MCITYI, MZIPI), :172 moves TRNIDINI into TRAN-ID and :173 performs READ-TRANSACT-FILE. The read at :269-278 states DATASET ('TRANSACT') INTO(TRAN-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF TRAN-RECORD) RIDFLD(TRAN-ID) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF TRAN-ID) UPDATE RESP RESP2, and the EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :280 takes its SECOND arm, WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND): :284 moves 'Y' into WS-ERR-FLG, :285-286 move the message, :287 moves -1 into TRNIDINL again and :288 sends the map. Control returns to the END-IF at :174, and :176 IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is now FALSE - a second test rather than an ELSE - so the thirteen record-to-screen moves at :177-190 and the send at :191 are SKIPPED. The task ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) of :136-139. THE MAP IS SENT EXACTLY ONCE, and that is the diagnostic difference from case05, which sends TWICE. The reason is structural rather than incidental: the unconditional PERFORM SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN at :109 belongs to the first-entry arm and is unreachable from the :110-111 else arm, so on the REENTER path the only send is the rejecting one inside the read. case05 reaches the identical NOTFND arm from :103-107 and then falls through to :109, which is why its fingerprint carries two sends of identical content and this one carries a single send. A fixture asserting two sends here would be describing case05 rather than this case, and the count is behaviour rather than bookkeeping. ALL THIRTEEN DETAIL FIELDS ARE SPACES, not LOW-VALUES and not record data. They were blanked at :159-171 before the read and the error flag then blocked :176, so nothing ever repainted them - the screen shows the operator an empty form with the message, which is the whole observable behaviour of a failed lookup. TRNIDINO retains the requested id, because COTRN1AO REDEFINES COTRN1AI so the received TRNIDINI occupies the same sixteen bytes and no arm of this path clears them. THE SEEDED RECORDS, AND WHY THEY ARE NOT AN EMPTY DATASET. TRANSACT has no ASCII fixture - app/data/ASCII holds exactly nine files and none is a transaction master - so the rows are declared inline and no tenth fixture is invented. Three rows are seeded and NONE of them carries the requested id, which is what makes this a genuine key miss rather than an empty-dataset artefact: an empty input would reach the same arm while proving only that a read of nothing finds nothing, and it could not distinguish a repository that compares keys from one that never looks. The three ids are chosen to catch the two ways a translation can fake this outcome. 0000000000000908 and 0000000000000910 BRACKET the missing 0000000000000909, one below and one above, so a repository that fell to a neighbouring record - a browse-and-read-next mistaken for a keyed read, or an off-by-one on the key comparison - would answer NORMAL with a record present and be caught by every one of the twenty-one pinned screen fields. 0000000000000904 is the third row and it is deliberately the SAME id as the CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED the commarea carries, because that field is read only at :103-107 inside the first-entry arm and must NOT be consulted here: on the REENTER path :172 keys the read from the TYPED TRNIDINI, so a translation that reached for the commarea selection instead would find 0904, report NORMAL, paint a full record and fail loudly rather than silently. Each row is 350 bytes, summed mechanically from the fourteen spans of app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy (practice B11): TRAN-ID X(16) 1-16, TRAN-TYPE-CD X(02) 17-18, TRAN-CAT-CD 9(04) 19-22, TRAN-SOURCE X(10) 23-32, TRAN-DESC X(100) 33-132, TRAN-AMT S9(09)V99 133-143, TRAN-MERCHANT-ID 9(09) 144-152, TRAN-MERCHANT-NAME X(50) 153-202, TRAN-MERCHANT-CITY X(50) 203-252, TRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP X(10) 253-262, TRAN-CARD-NUM X(16) 263-278, TRAN-ORIG-TS X(26) 279-304, TRAN-PROC-TS X(26) 305-330 and FILLER X(20) 331-350. The FILLER is present and space-filled (gate G21): it is a span rather than a gap, and omitting it would leave every row 330 bytes. TRAN-AMT occupies ELEVEN bytes - nine integer digits and two fractional, scale 2 (gate G23) - with the sign OVERPUNCHED into the trailing byte 143 and never carried in a twelfth byte or a leading sign position: '0000009084B' is +908.42 because B is the positive overpunch for 2, and '0000009105N' is -910.55 because N is the negative overpunch for 5. PIC X spans are space-padded and PIC 9 spans zero-filled. Both timestamps of every row are PINNED 26-byte literals in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmmmmm shape - 4+1+2+1+2+1+2+1+2+1+2+1+6 = 26 - and never a captured 'now' (practice B7). None of the record content is ever painted on this path, so the descriptions say what each row is FOR; the projection of a record that IS painted is case08's subject. THE ERROR MESSAGE, BYTE-EXACT. The literal at :285-286 is 'Transaction ID NOT found...' - upper-case NOT, three trailing dots - reproduced character for character with no normalisation of either. It is asserted on both channels at their own widths because :217 moves WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) and COBOL discards the two rightmost bytes: WS_MESSAGE_80 carries the 27-character literal followed by 53 spaces, and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 the same literal followed by 51. THERE IS NO DISPLAY LINE, and that omission is deliberate. The program's only DISPLAY is 'RESP:' WS-RESP-CD 'REAS:' WS-REAS-CD at :290, which sits inside the WHEN OTHER arm of the same EVALUATE; the NOTFND arm at :283-288 emits nothing to the operator console. Adding one here would assert an output the COBOL does not produce and would claim the third arm was taken when the second was. THE HIGHLIGHT, and a finding this fixture records rather than invents. Gate G38 asks that the CSSETATY error highlight apply only in REENTER state. This case is REENTER AND in error, which is the combination in which a highlighting screen would highlight - and COTRN01C still applies none, because it has no highlighting to apply. The program's eight COPY statements at :52-72 are COCOM01Y, COTRN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA: CSSETATY is NOT among them, the source contains zero occurrences of DFHRED and no FLG-<field>-NOT-OK pair for a resolver to act on, and no attribute byte is moved anywhere in its 330 lines. COTRN01C therefore satisfies G38 in the strongest available form - no highlight in EITHER state - and 'attributes' is present and EMPTY rather than absent, which is the positive statement that the decision was taken through the same FieldAttributeSetter the highlighting screens use and came back untouched. Pinning a DFHRED on TRNIDIN would assert an attribute the program never writes (practice B4: document, never invent). METADATA IS NOT PAYLOAD. The xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items of the symbolic map are length, flag and attribute metadata and never payload members, which is why none of them appears among the twenty-one fields. TRNIDINL is the one that matters here: -1 is moved into it twice on this path, at :154 and again at :287, and -1 in an xxxL item is the CURSOR request, so it is reported once as cursorField exactly as AAP section 0.3.9 requires. THE I/O OUTCOME (gate G47). This case is the DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm - RESP 13, the CICS face of the batch FILE STATUS '23' that common.FileStatus names NOT_FOUND - of the program's single keyed-read call site, and it is reached from REAL SEEDED DATA rather than from a forced outcome: forcedOutcomes is empty, and the read answers from the rows above by comparing the record's own 16-byte TRAN-ID span against the key :172 left in the field. The repository returns that as a DISCRIMINATED OUTCOME carrying the status with its RESP and RESP2 and NEVER abends on the caller's behalf, which is what lets the COBOL's own EVALUATE structure survive the translation unchanged; an exception would have unwound past :176 and lost the second test altogether. :275 states the UPDATE option, so the read takes a record lock, and TRANSACT's final state is pinned UNCHANGED to prove the lock was not followed by a write - a not-found key cannot rewrite what it did not find. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): the whole 218-byte area travels in the payload and nothing is held server-side. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160 bytes and the CDEMO-CT01-INFO extension at :53-61 is 16 + 16 + 8 + 1 + 1 + 16 = 58, which is 218 in all; the 58-byte extension is carried as its own field rather than folded into the 160-byte context all seventeen controllers depend on, and all 22 fields are pinned so none is left unchecked. The AID travels in the payload too. This case supplies a realistic re-entry rather than a bare context byte - the operator arrived from CT00/COTRN00C on page 1 of a browse spanning 0904 to 0910, selected 0904, and has now typed a different id over the field - and every one of those values comes back exactly as it arrived, because no arm of this path writes a CDEMO- field. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT remains 1. A field the passed area does not name keeps what its picture gives it, spaces for PIC X and zeros for PIC 9. nextProgram carries COTRN01C because the task ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:388-398 binds TRANSACTION(CT01) to PROGRAM(COTRN01C), so the operator's next input returns to this same program; nextMapset and nextMap carry the COTRN01 and COTRN1A the SEND at :219-225 names; and termination is RETURN_TRANSID. There is NO EXEC CICS XCTL on this path, so no transfer target is invented and the XCTL of :205-208 stays unreached. THE RETURN CODE IS 0. COTRN01C contains zero CALL 'CEE3ABD' sites, so a failed lookup is a screen error rather than an abend - the operator is told and the transaction returns normally. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, READ-TRANSACT-FILE, SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY and app/bms/COTRN01.bms) and the file and transaction definitions in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:76-87. Both the record images and the twenty-one widths were computed from those span tables rather than typed by eye, and every length was measured programmatically. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. DFHAID and DFHBMSCA are IBM-supplied and absent from this repository (risk R-D), so the DFHENTER this case names is the mnemonic common.CicsAid reproduces from IBM CICS documentation. No user rules were provided for this project - review_rules returns exactly 'No user rules provided.' - so the AAP section 0.10.2 practices bind instead, and their absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G19 (three 350-byte records, each pinned as a whole image so the total width is asserted), G21 (FILLER present and space-filled at 331-350), G23 (both amounts are scale 2 with the sign overpunched into byte 143), G30 (both ordered EVALUATEs honoured in source order - EIBAID at :112 takes the first of its five arms and WS-RESP-CD at :280 the SECOND of its three, with WHEN OTHER last in each and never reached here), G37, G38 (REENTER WITH error, and still no highlight, because this program has none), G47 (the NOTFND / '23' outcome, reached from seeded data and reported as a discriminated value rather than an exception) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this program or this path has none of them: G32 (zero GO TO in COTRN01C), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0), G39 (no pagination), G40 (no XCTL on this path) and G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC). COTRN01C performs no arithmetic at all - zero ADD, SUBTRACT, COMPUTE, MULTIPLY and DIVIDE - and ROUNDED appears zero times in it as in all 28 programs, so any scaling is RoundingMode.DOWN by rule R2. Dead working storage is left exactly as it stands (practice B5): WS-USR-MODIFIED at :45-47 is set at :89 and never tested again, and WS-TRAN-DATE PIC X(08) VALUE '00/00/00' at :50 is never referenced at all; neither is asserted, and neither is tidied away.
